0x10056160.name: Unit10055A60_MinOf10055F60OverIndexPairs
0x10056160.evidence: Body: for each pair of 24-bit indices in the list at this+0x14, calls FUN_10055F60(point[a], point[b], &out, param_3) on the 0x20-byte records at this+0x10; keeps the smallest result (start 1e9) and copies its out xyz to param_2 with w = 1.0; returns the smallest.
0x10056160.summary: Returns the smallest value 0x10055F60 gives over the object's index pairs, and the point it gave with it.
